title: Going Medieval
shortDescription: Build and manage your own castle settlement in a land reclaimed by wilderness. With detailed management, survival strategy, and a moddable sandbox world, Going Medieval challenges you to build the mightiest colony this side of the apocalypse.
zhShortDescription: 3D 殖民模拟，建造多层城堡、管理居民心理。
description: When civilization is decimated by rampant plague, a lucky few emerge from the ashes. Help them settle in a dangerous wilderness reclaimed by nature. Build them a home, shape their lives, and defend them from bandits and beasts in a lawless, realistic post-calamity world. The Dark Age is yours to rebuild. From three lost travellers to a thriving walled city, build greatness from desolation. Use 3D terrain tools to create the perfect stronghold, from sprawling multi-storey forts to winding underground caverns. Construct, furnish and decorate your chambers, workshops, chapels, libraries and more, using stone, clay, and other gathered materials. Each settler is a unique character. zhDescription: 《前往中世纪》是灾后中世纪世界的3D殖民模拟游戏。带领幸存者从零建造定居点。多层建筑系统可以建造真正意义上的城堡。居民有独立心理状态、技能和需求。
metaDescriptionEn: Going Medieval review — multi-level castle builder. Z-level design, settler mood, winter survival, defense.
metaDescriptionZh: 《前往中世纪》Steam 评测与介绍 — 多层城堡建造模拟。Z 轴建筑设计、居民心情管理、冬季生存。

topReviews.review:
NEEDS a family mechanic. This is a massive, fundamental flaw. The entire concept of "medieval" society is built on the backbone of bloodlines, dynasties, and family units.

When you think of a medieval settlement, you think of building a homestead for a family, passing down a blacksmith trade from father to daughter, or cementing alliances. Stripping that out doesn't just feel like a missing feature; it actively guts the roleplay and immersion of the entire era.

Instead, Going Medieval forces you into this bizarre, clinical loop where your colony is basically just a glorified commune or an ov…
topReviews.zh_review: 急需家族系统。这是一个巨大的根本性缺陷。'中世纪'社会的整个概念建立在血统、王朝和家庭单元的基石上。当你想到中世纪定居点，你想到的是为家族建造家园、父女传承铁匠手艺、缔结联盟。去掉这些不仅是缺失功能——它直接掏空了整个时代的角色扮演和沉浸感。相反，《前往中世纪》把你困在一个奇怪的、冷漠的循环中，你的殖民地基本上只是一个高级公社。

topReviews.review: Very nice game, but please add the ability to make new child settlers.
topReviews.zh_review: 非常好的游戏，但请加入生育小孩的设定。

whyPlay: Going Medieval's killer feature is its Z-level system — you build multi-story castles with underground vaults, rooftop battlements, and murder holes. The structural integrity simulation means your castle can collapse if you dig too greedily. Settler psychology adds RimWorld-style emergent stories. It's still early access but the vertical building alone makes it unique in the genre.
whyPlayZh: 《前往中世纪》的杀手锏是 Z 轴系统——你能建造多层城堡，包括地下金库、屋顶城垛和杀戮孔。结构完整性模拟意味着挖得太贪心城堡会塌。居民心理系统加入了边缘世界式的涌现叙事。还在 EA 但光是垂直建造就让它在这个类型中独树一帜。
